reason: I have 11 to 20 techs and two locations, and I only try what another Vietnamese salon owner I know already runs, and nobody in my Zalo group has mentioned this. The terms are fair, but I am not putting my Saturdays and my techs' pay on a new app from strangers.
objection: I just bought my hardware and I'm tied to my current setup. Even with the old system kept, my techs get confused, and if the payout sheet is wrong once I have angry techs. I don't know anyone who uses it.
would_change_my_mind: Two or three Vietnamese salon owners I know, with similar size, telling me in my Zalo or Facebook group that they run it and the tip and payout numbers were right.
